When every device of yours is closed or in the background, the bouncer waits this long and then tells the network you are away. It stays connected either way — this only changes what other people see. Pick \"never\" to keep the away flag off entirely.
Used when you leave without typing one (/quit, /part). Empty the field to go back to the server message.
